Inflation sits back in the spotlight after the latest US consumer price report came in hotter than forecasts, and higher interest rates are back on the table. When borrowing costs stay elevated, cash flow matters more than ever because it shows how much real money a business generates after the headlines fade. This article walks through three cash rich stocks that our screen flags as priced below their estimated fair value today.

The three stocks in this article are just a small sample, and the full screen on Simply Wall St surfaced 97 more companies with equally compelling cash flow stories that are not covered here. To go beyond the shortlist and start identifying your own high conviction ideas, head straight into the Undervalued Stocks Based On Cash Flows screener.

Crocs (CROX)

Crocs is a casual footwear group whose Crocs and HEYDUDE brands turn global clog, sandal, and sneaker sales into the cash flows that anchor this screener. The Crocs line produces about US$3.4b of revenue, HEYDUDE adds roughly US$700 million, and the stock's market value is around US$7.2b.

Crocs fits this cash-flow-heavy screen because its clogs and casual shoes convert everyday store and online sales into meaningful operating cash, and according to olexander_ua, an investor in the Simply Wall St Community, that cash generation underpins a potentially attractive long term setup.

"Revenue growing from $4.04B to ~$5.28B by Year 5. FCF margin expanding from ~16% today to 25% (strong operating leverage as HEYDUDE turns around and DTC mix grows)"

What happens if a single assumption in that margin story shifts, positively or negatively, will matter a lot for long term returns.

If that margin picture is what decides the real payoff, read the full narrative for Crocs to see how Crocs' cash engine could accelerate or stall from here.

NasdaqGS:CROX Earnings & Revenue Growth as at Nov 2026
Alphabet (GOOGL)

Alphabet matters for this cash flow focused screen because its Google Cloud and AI platforms turn recurring cloud usage into hard currency, while the wider Google Services empire supplies the scale. According to oscargarcia, an investor in the Simply Wall St Community, that combination changes how investors think about Alphabet's long term cash engine.

Alphabet runs a global digital platform group built around Google Search, YouTube and Android, with Google Services producing about US$376.3b of revenue, Google Cloud adding roughly US$93.2b, and Other Bets about US$1.5b, against a roughly US$3.7t market value.

"Google Cloud has gone from "meh" to money-maker. • Now #3 globally behind AWS and Azure, with over 11% market share."

title: Packaging, Package Delivery and Pickup Trucks: $90,000 Across These 3 Household Names Pays $5,067 a Year

Packaging, Package Delivery and Pickup Trucks: $90,000 Across These 3 Household Names Pays $5,067 a Year
David Beren
Sat, November 14, 2026 at 9:58 AM PST 5 min read
F

AMCR
AMZN

Quick Read

Splitting $90,000 evenly across Amcor, UPS and Ford would generate about $5,000 a year in dividends, an average yield near 6%.

Citigroup's analyst pressed UPS on dividend coverage, and CEO Carol Tomé answered "our dividend is safe and secure."

Ford trades at about 4 times free cash flow, which lifts its yield above 5% despite uneven earnings.

Read More: Learn 7 ways to generate income with a $1,000,000+ portfolio (sponsor)

Three companies behind everyday packaging, parcel delivery, and pickup trucks all pay quarterly dividends. Had you put $30,000 into each of these three (a packaging maker, a parcel carrier, and an automaker), the $90,000 total would return about $5,067 a year in passive income.

RiverNorthPhotography / Getty Images

For retirees living off a portfolio, that cash shows up on a schedule, no matter what the market does. Here's what a $30,000 stake in each of these three high-yield names would return using each company's latest regular quarterly dividend, annualized at Nov. 13, 2026 prices, so they'll shift as prices and dividends change.

Ford Motor Turns Pickups Into a 5.03% Yield

Stock #3: Ford Motor (NYSE:F)

Yield (forward, regular dividend only): 5.03%

Shares for $30,000: 2,516.78

Annual Passive Income: ~$1,510

Ford makes gas and hybrid vehicles, sells work trucks and vans through Ford Pro, develops EVs in Model e, and loans to buyers through Ford Credit. The regular dividend has stayed at $0.15 every quarter in 2026, and the latest one is due Dec. 1. The larger payments in February 2024 ($0.33) and February 2025 ($0.30) aren't counted here.

The yield is high mostly because the stock trades at about 4 times free cash flow. In the third quarter, Ford returned $4.7 billion of adjusted free cash flow and ended the period with $25.3 billion in cash. It also reaffirmed full-year guidance of $6.0 billion to $7.0 billion. Uneven earnings remain the chief concern, as Ford posted a $1.327 billion second-quarter net loss after special charges, and management expects Model e to lose about $4 billion this year.

title: Bilibili (NasdaqGS:BILI) Stock Sees Modest Fair Value Cut After Mixed Analyst Commentary
detail:
Bilibili (NasdaqGS:BILI) Stock Sees Modest Fair Value Cut After Mixed Analyst Commentary
Al Bentley
Fri, November 13, 2026 at 9:13 PM PST 3 min read
BILI
C
Explore stocks on Coinbase
Trading disclosure

Bilibili is back in focus as analysts adjust price targets around the stock. A trim from US$27 to US$26.50 sits alongside targets such as US$26.50 and US$23, which ties directly to the mixed commentary on Q3 results, execution risk and how quickly engagement might translate into revenue. In the sections that follow, you will see how these shifting targets fit into the broader Bilibili story and how to keep track of the evolving analyst narrative.

Stay updated as the Fair Value for Bilibili shifts by adding it to your watchlist or portfolio. Alternatively, explore our Community to discover new perspectives on Bilibili.

What Wall Street Has Been Saying
🐂 Bullish Takeaways

Citi keeps a Buy rating on Bilibili while trimming its price target to US$26.50 from US$27, which signals ongoing confidence in the stock despite the slight adjustment.

Citi describes the latest Q3 report as largely inline, with only slightly below consensus sales, which some investors may view as a sign that the broader business story is still intact.

BNP Paribas initiated coverage of Bilibili with an Outperform rating and a US$23 price target, which adds another supportive voice to the current analyst mix.

🐻 Bearish Takeaways

The cut in Citi's price target, even if small, highlights questions about how quickly Bilibili can convert engagement into revenue growth that matches prior expectations.

The comment on Q3 sales coming in slightly below consensus underlines execution risk for Bilibili, especially for investors who are sensitive to any shortfall versus market forecasts.

Do your thoughts align with the Bull or Bear Analysts? Perhaps you think there's more to the story. Head to the Simply Wall St Community to discover more perspectives!

The Net Profit Margin assumption has adjusted from 8.56% to 8.32% in CN¥ terms.

The assumed future P/E multiple has changed from 27.14x to 27.07x.

The Discount Rate has moved from 10.06% to 10.17% in the model.

title: Citibank Announces $2.2 Billion Redemption of 4.876% Fixed Rate / Floating Rate Notes Due 2027 and $800.0 Million Redemption of Floating Rate Notes Due 2027
detail:

Citibank Announces $2.2 Billion Redemption of 4.876% Fixed Rate / Floating Rate Notes Due 2027 and $800.0 Million Redemption of Floating Rate Notes Due 2027
Business Wire
Fri, November 13, 2026 at 1:15 PM PST 2 min read
C
Trade C on Coinbase
Trading disclosure

NEW YORK, November 13, 2026--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Citibank, N.A. is announcing the redemption, in whole, constituting $2,200,000,000 of its 4.876% Fixed Rate / Floating Rate Notes due 2027 (the "fixed rate / floating rate notes") (ISIN: US17325FBL13) and $800,000,000 of its Floating Rate Notes due 2027 (the "floating rate notes" and together with the fixed rate / floating rate notes, the "notes") (ISIN: US17325FBM95).

The redemption date for the notes is November 19, 2026 (the "redemption date"). The cash redemption price for the notes payable on the redemption date will equal par plus accrued and unpaid interest to, but excluding, the redemption date.

The redemptions announced today are consistent with Citibank's liability management strategy and reflect its ongoing efforts to enhance the efficiency of its funding and capital structure. Citibank will continue to consider opportunities to redeem or repurchase securities, based on several factors, including without limitation, the economic value, regulatory changes, potential impact on Citibank's net interest margin and borrowing costs, the overall remaining tenor of Citibank's debt portfolio, capital impact, as well as overall market conditions.

Beginning on the redemption date, interest will no longer accrue on the notes.

Citibank, N.A. is the paying agent for the notes.

About Citi

Citi is a preeminent banking partner for institutions with cross-border needs, a global leader in wealth management and a valued personal bank in its home market of the United States. Citi does business in more than 180 countries and jurisdictions, providing corporations, governments, investors, institutions and individuals with a broad range of financial products and services.
